Plot the simulated data: phylogenetic forest and VAF spectra.

Source: R/plot_data.R
plot_data.Rd

Samples `n_cells` cells from each sample and restricts the forest to their branches. Top: the forest coloured by species (plot_forest()) and with the driver branch and the truncal node highlighted (plot_sticks()). Bottom: pairwise and marginal VAF spectra of the sorted samples (plot_vaf()), with mutations labelled as truncal, driver (acquired on the branch from the root to the first cell of `driver_mutant`) or subclonal.

Usage

plot_data(
  forest,
  muts,
  n_cells = 50,
  seed = NULL,
  driver_mutant = "B",
  vaf_cut = 0.03,
  cls = c(subclonal = "gainsboro", driver = "forestgreen", truncal = "darkgoldenrod3")
)

Arguments

forest

Table of forest nodes (see plot_forest()).

muts

Mutation table with VAF columns and `first_cell_id`.

n_cells

Number of cells drawn from each sample.

seed

Optional seed for the cell sampling.

driver_mutant

Name of the driver mutant.

vaf_cut

Minimum VAF shown in the marginal histograms.

cls

Named vector of colors for the labels `subclonal`, `driver`, `truncal`.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

data("forest")
data("muts")
PEPI:::plot_data(forest, muts, seed = 31)
